title: Structure guided design and molecular modelling of a novel peptide–SWCNT biosensor targeting NS1 dengue virus
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,44173-44193

Mut-11, a designed peptide, selectively binds DENV-2 NS1 and stably interacts with SWCNTs in silico. Experimental studies are needed to confirm its biosensor potential.
